scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.verify:deploy: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:deploy && pnpm --filter @workspace/well-tutored test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:smoke && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm run test:database-config && pnpm run check:test-database && pnpm run prepare:test-database && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/well-tutored test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:smoke && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
